age_estimator_notes.shear: discharge_class is 'chronic': the source was under way, so the slick's long axis is the vessel's TRACK, not a patch spread by the ocean. Reading an age off it would be meaningless. The gate is correct and nothing is missing.
age_estimator_notes.fay: no independently reported release volume. Deriving V from area_km2 x a thickness class -- as the brief suggests -- is circular, because the observed area then appears on both sides of the spreading law. Pass --volume-m3 from the official finding (e.g. Huntington: 588 barrels = 93.5 m3, NTSB MIR-24-01).
